text:
sasha: Quick check-in - upcoming product launch + benchmark webinar. Need an SEO action list: KW map, schema, internal hub linking, safe redirects, and form UTM routing. Goal: organic signups and clear conversion path.

liam: I can take keyword clustering and anchor suggestions. Focusing on commercial-intent queries like "LLM inference platform pricing" and "GPU inference latency". I'll deliver 10 prioritized KW groups.

emily: I'll own page schema + OG. Plan: Webinar page -> Event + HowTo (registration steps) + FAQ. Benchmark post -> Article + Dataset/SoftwareSource.

sasha: Good. ravi, can you do redirects and canonical compliance? Keep rewrites minimal and TTL short.

ravi: yep. Proposed NGINX rewrites:

```
# short-lived redirects
rewrite ^/launch-old$ /announcements/launch-2026 permanent;
rewrite ^/bench-old/(.*)$ /benchmarks/2026/$1 permanent;
```

ravi: will also add <link rel="canonical"> to templates and check robots.txt.

liam: Internal linking plan: create /guides/llm-inference as hub. Hub -> benchmark -> benchmark-methods -> pricing calc -> signup. Anchor text priority: exact KW once per hub page, then variations.

emily: Schema example for event (include registration url + timezone + performer):

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference - Launch & Benchmark",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T18:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar?utm_source=webinar_x"},
  "offers": {"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.example.com/register?utm_source=webinar_x"}
}
```

emily: also add Article schema with 'isAccessibleForFree': 'False' for gated benchmark.

sasha: For lead routing: include utm_campaign=launch_may and utm_medium=webinar. Forms should map region select to queues: APAC -> "Launch APAC", EMEA -> "Launch EMEA", NAM -> "Launch NAM".

ravi: I'll add server-side capture of UTM params into form submission metadata.

liam: I'll post KW sheet: https://docs.example.com/sheets/kw-launch-2620 and an anchor map in the same doc. Expect for review by EOD.

emily: I'll push draft OG + schema to docs: https://docs.example.com/drafts/schema-launch-2620

deploy-bot: ci/link-scan started on https://staging.redwood.example.com/announcements/launch-2026 - 1 warning (image without 'loading=lazy'). Report: /ci/reports/scan-2620

sasha: Timeline: KW + anchor map by today EOD. Schema + OG by tomorrow. Redirect PR by end of week. Content freeze Tue for dry-run.

ravi: Opening PR for redirects: https://git.example.com/redwood/www/merge_requests/360

liam: KW sheet shared. Noted commercial+comparison intent buckets.

sasha: small SEO hygiene: canonicalize hub -> blog, use OG:description with primary KW, add hreflang only if translated pages exist. Compress hero images.

emily: Adding sample CLI to benchmark post (non-executable):

```bash
rwd-bench --model rwd-13b --tokens 1024 --concurrency 4 --iters 5
```

sasha: Thanks team. Tag PRs in this thread. If blockers, ping @sasha. :mag_right: :rocket:
